stories.title: Del desahucio de Maricarmen al decreto dinamitado por Junts: los ocho días que agitaron la vivienda en España

en.title: From Maricarmen's eviction to the decree dynamited by Junts: the eight days that shook housing in Spain
en.summary: Street pressure, particularly in Madrid, prompted PSOE and Sumar to agree on two housing measures being voted on in Congress today, which Catalan independentists have announced they will reject.

stories.title: Junts rechaza los decretos de vivienda y pone al Gobierno contra las cuerdas

en.title: Junts rejects housing decrees and puts the Government in a tight spot
en.summary: The Government disregarded demands to withdraw the measures and challenged the independentists to show their allegiance by voting with PP and Vox.

stories.title: ‘Digger’, com Tom Cruise: Nada de nada

en.title: 'Digger', with Tom Cruise: Nothing at all
en.summary: Iñárritu transforms a story about humanity's end into a hysterical, pretentious, and narratively disastrous spectacle.

stories.title: Segundo día del temporal de lluvias torrenciales y persistentes: persiste el rojo en Tarragona y Castellón

en.title: Second day of torrential and persistent rainfall: red alert persists in Tarragona and Castellón
en.summary: Spain continues experiencing severe weather with red alerts in Tarragona and Castellón, while multiple other regions face orange or yellow warnings.

stories.title: Obsesión por el crecimiento rápido: la IA puede caer en el mismo error que las redes sociales

en.title: Obsession with rapid growth: AI may fall into the same error as social media

stories.title: El Gobierno se niega a retirar los decretos de Vivienda: «Ha llegado la hora de que PP, Vox y Junts se retraten»

en.title: Government refuses to withdraw housing decrees: "It is time for PP, Vox and Junts to account for themselves"
en.summary: The Spanish government maintains its position on two housing decrees scheduled for a congressional vote Friday despite Junts' refusal to support them unless they are withdrawn and replaced.

stories.title: Cuidado con lo que publicas: el error en redes que te puede costar el despido estando de baja

en.title: Be careful what you post: the social media mistake that could cost you your job while on sick leave
en.summary: Employees on sick leave who post on social media risk employment consequences, as activity on platforms may be used as evidence against dismissal claims.

stories.title: Lluvias torrenciales dejan a oscuras pueblos de Castellón y se activa la alerta hidrológica

en.title: Heavy rainfall leaves towns in Castellón without power and triggers hydrological alert
en.summary: Intense rainfall centered on the Castellón municipality of Aín caused power outages in several towns and activated regional flood warnings.

stories.title: Junts rechaza el decreto de vivienda y mete a Sánchez en la UCI: "Es terrible, un fracaso"

en.title: Junts rejects housing decree and puts Sánchez in critical condition: "It is terrible, a failure"
en.summary: The independence party demands the government revise the housing decree to include their demands or they will block it. The executive has not planned for this scenario.

stories.title: Ayuso reacciona en directo al doble portazo de Junts a los decretos de vivienda: "Sánchez va a llevar a España a la revolución. Prepara el terreno para elecciones"

en.title: Ayuso reacts on air to Junts' double rejection of housing decrees: "Sánchez will lead Spain to revolution. He is preparing the ground for elections"
en.summary: Madrid's regional president Ayuso criticized the Government's housing decrees amid Junts' rejection, alleging the executive is deliberately creating tension and laying groundwork for early elections.

stories.title: Junts tumbará los dos decretos de vivienda y priva al Gobierno de una victoria que le dé oxígeno

en.title: Junts will block both housing decrees and deny the Government a victory that gives it oxygen

en.title: The majority of Americans blame Trump for high prices
en.summary: Sixty-five percent of American adults hold the US president's policies responsible for increased food and consumer prices.

stories.title: Los juristas temen una oleada de litigios por el decreto de vivienda: "Es demencial, parece propaganda"
